name: Enterprise Authentication & Multi-Tenant Access Migration
description: Comprehensive migration of user authentication to support multi-tenant workspaces, 2FA/TOTP setup, role-based access control (Admin, Member, Viewer), and secure secrets management via HashiCorp Vault. Includes auditing session handling, token verification, and redirect safety on mobile platforms.
key_outcomes: Reduced unauthorized session access attempts to zero
blockers: Cross-domain session cookie scoping issues on mobile Safari
Token refresh race conditions under concurrent client requests
Vault policy setup latency during initial staging setup
implementation_details: Implemented JWT rotation with Refresh Token cookies, integrated TOTP QR code generation, and setup HashiCorp Vault secrets storage for environment isolation.

name: Production Monitoring & Auto-Scaling Infrastructure Setup
description: Establish automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, configure Docker Compose environments for local development, and deploy cloud-scale monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, and auto-scaling rules on Kubernetes clusters.
key_outcomes: 99.95% system uptime achieved after dashboards launched
Auto-scaling triggers respond within 45 seconds of load spikes
Developer local setup time reduced from days to one command
blockers: Metric scraping permission limits on Kubernetes pod namespaces
GitHub Actions runner timeout on large container image builds
implementation_details: Created helm charts, configured Prometheus alertmanager routes, and built multi-stage Dockerfiles with layer caching.

name: Real-time Collaborative Kanban Workspace & Document Sync
description: Designing and building a highly interactive drag-and-drop Kanban Board with real-time editing syncing via WebSockets to backend stores. Explored real-time collaborative conflict resolution spikes utilizing CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types like Yjs) for shared editing workspace.
key_outcomes: Achieved sub-100ms sync latency across concurrent sessions
Robust state merging with zero data conflicts on concurrency spikes
Frictionless Kanban state transitions under heavy user load
blockers: WebSocket connection drops on erratic client network conditions
CRDT state garbage collection memory growth during long sessions
implementation_details: Built Yjs provider over WebSockets, implemented optimistic UI updates for card drags, and added sync state reconnection handlers.

name: E-Commerce Checkout Flow, EU Tax Integration & Load Testing
description: Creating robust end-to-end integration tests for payment validation modules and EU orders tax/VAT calculation services (specifically handling German/French tax offsets). Validated peak traffic performance with k6 simulating 500 concurrent active checkout users.
key_outcomes: Ensured 100% tax calculation accuracy for cross-border EU purchases
Identified and patched 2 race conditions during database checkouts
Validated checkout endpoint average response time remains under 250ms
blockers: Stripe webhook delivery latency during sandbox test runs
Database lock contention on inventory tables during high k6 load spikes
implementation_details: Integrated Stripe Elements checkout, added automated VAT rate resolution by country code, and performed load simulation with k6 scripts.

name: Interactive Client Dashboard & Filtered Reporting Engine
description: Design and build a responsive mobile-friendly dashboard using modern shimmer skeleton states during loading, and implement an interactive drag-and-drop custom report builder with multi-column filters to export files.
key_outcomes: Export capability supports tables of up to 10k rows instantly
Dashboard load feels 40% faster due to skeleton component integration
Smooth layout adaptation across tablet, mobile, and ultra-wide screens
blockers: Large dataset memory overhead during client-side CSV generation
Chart rerender lag when switching time-series date filters quickly
implementation_details: Built custom virtualized grid components, integrated Web Workers for off-thread CSV formatting, and optimized Chart.js canvas rendering.
